correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed from the explicit matrix (columns (1,x), x in GF(2)^3): A8 has rank 4, 56 bases, is 3-connected, beta(A8)=6. Stabilizer in GL(4,2) has order 1344 with GF(2)^4-orbits of sizes 1/8/7 (re-enumerated from full GL(4,2) of size 20160 independently of the candidate script). Hence exactly three binary column-addition signatures. Per-orbit invariants recomputed by two routes independent of the candidate deletion-contraction code: (a) chi'-Mobius beta, (b) rank-generating-function Tutte expansion: E0_loop 56 bases beta 0 (1-sep present); E2_parallel 84 bases beta 6 (unique 2-sep {0,8}|rest); E1_simple 88 bases beta 7, 3-connected with exactly ten 3-separations with sides>=3 and lambda<3 (6 of type 4|5 with lambda 2, e.g. {0,1,2,3}|{4,5,6,7,8} with r=3/3, plus 4 of type 3|6), so not internally 4-connected under the standard definition (3-connected plus no 3-separation with both sides>=4). T(1,1)=#bases holds in all cases. Literal rank-5 picture spot-verified: N(c)/8=A8 holds (checked c=0,1,3,255; code asserts all 256), rank 5, row-space size 16 with 16 cosets (independently recomputed), per-orbit (56,beta0)/(84,beta6)/(88,beta7) with separator counts 1/8/42, 0/1/14, 0/0/10 matching the rank-4 table. Scope is binary extensions (target explicitly says 'to 9-element binary matroids'); completeness uses unique GF(2)-representability of the 3-connected binary base, so non-binary extensions are out of scope, not a gap. Admission naming slip ('AG(3,2) minus a point' for an 8-point matrix that is the full AG(3,2)) is honestly corrected by fixing the matrix; all numerics keyed to the matrix.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively. Mayhew-Royle math/0702316 catalogues all matroids to 9 elements with counts/database but publishes no A8-anchored single-element coextension orbit table with per-orbit beta deletion-contraction logs and internal-4-connectivity verdicts. Kingan-Lemos Strong Splitter 1201.4427 proves the general single-element-step theorem (at most two consecutive extensions) but computes no A8 cell, no beta values 0/6/7, no separator lists. Adiprasito-Huh-Katz / Dohmen-Trinks / Breuer-Klivans treat general Kahler package, broken-circuit beta, and non-Tutte arboricity respectively; none records this cell. The orbit sizes 1/8/7 as abstract AGL(3,2) action are elementary, but the packaged per-orbit (bases, beta, Tutte table, separator census, 3-connectivity verdict) for this fixed anchor is not published and is not mechanically implied: beta varies (0 vs 6 vs 7) and the ten explicit lambda-2 separators of E1 require computation. No renaming or parameter substitution found. Internal prior scan (SCOPE047/051/026, failure censuses) covers different bases/slices.

residual_risks: Completeness is within binary extensions (as the target states); non-binary single-element extensions of A8 are not enumerated.

Internal-4-connectivity uses the standard definition (no 3-separation with both sides>=4); the '10 violations' count includes four trivial 3|6 separations, but six genuine 4|5 violations sustain the verdict.
